title: Advance Tax Provisions and Interest under Section 234A, 234B, and 234C
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Advance tax is payable during the financial year in quarterly installments if total estimated net tax liability (after TDS) is ₹10,000 or more. Payment schedule: 15% by June 15, 45% by September 15, 75% by December 15, and 100% by March 15. Shortfall in advance tax triggers interest under Section 234C (1% per month for deferment) and Section 234B (1% per month for default in payment of advance tax). Late filing of ITR triggers penal interest under Section 234A.
